gloss: first meeting; first time meeting someone

definitions.explanation: The first time meeting someone face to face.

examples.japanese: {初対面|しょたいめん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{話|はな}す→話す：00467_hanasu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{緊張|きんちょう}する→緊張する：20557_kinchousuru⟧。
examples.english: I get nervous talking to people I'm meeting for the first time.

examples.japanese: {初対面|しょたいめん}な⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{親|した}しく→親しい：02345_shitashii⟧⟦{話|はな}して→話す：00467_hanasu⟧⟦くれた→くれる：00724_kureru⟧。
examples.english: Even though it was our first meeting, they talked to me in a friendly way.

examples.japanese: {初対面|しょたいめん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{敬語|けいご}→敬語：04022_keigo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{普通|ふつう}→普通：01502_futsuu⟧だ。
examples.english: It's normal to use polite language when meeting someone for the first time.

notes:
FORMS:
⟦{初|しょ}→初〜：03955_sho⟧ (first) + ⟦{対面|たいめん}→対面：10377_taimen⟧ (meeting face to face) → first face-to-face meeting

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {初対面|しょたいめん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧ - a person you're meeting for the first time
- {初対面|しょたいめん}な⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ - even though it's the first meeting
- {初対面|しょたいめん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ - at a first meeting

CULTURAL NOTE:
In Japanese culture, {初対面|しょたいめん} situations typically call for more formal language and behavior. Using polite speech (⟦{敬語|けいご}→敬語：04022_keigo⟧) and maintaining appropriate distance are expected.
